notes.title: Camping Builder Demo Teaser and release date!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/0334b5a1ffec1f34bcc525b1785642ab79407050.png[/img]

[h3]Demo date - revealed![/h3]

Here we go. The super-anticipated demo of our simulator [b]Camping Builder[/b] will be out on the[b] 21st of February[/b], as a part of the Steam Next Festival. We simply cannot wait to show you how this incredible game combines the builder/decorator simulation with an ecological aspect, all wrapped up in an engaging story. 

Check out the new teaser we've prepared for you. It only shows a tiny bit of what the game has to offer!


[previewyoutube=d9-MgYHmLSg;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]The Steam Next Festival[/b], a big celebration of Indie games, will be held on Steam from the [b]21st to the 28th of February[/b]. If you want to participate in it, you will be able to play plenty of great game demos for free - totally worth your time! As always, we are bringing out the big guns for that occasion, holding the daily streams, Q&A's and competitions for you to participate in.



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1545510/Camping_Builder/

So hurry up, [b]add the Camping Builder to your wishlist[/b] now and celebrate the Steam Next Fest with us next month!

notes.title: Community Discord server - small changes and unification
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38824567/f6ee1f3169f30ef351db127f1fec98ee83317fa9.png[/img]
Hello there, faithful fans! 


We are making small changes to our Discord server that was made for our other game, Hotel Renovator.

Hotel Renovator is just one of our upcoming games focused on building and renovation. Recently we’ve launched a dedicated Discord Server for the Hotel but we’ve decided to change it a little bit and add all of our Builder/Renovator titles to the server and make it about them. 

So, since today on our Discord, you will find additional categories for games like:
Camping Builder: https://bit.ly/CampingBuilderSteam
Aquapark Renovator: https://bit.ly/AquaparkRenovator
Airport Renovator: https://bit.ly/AirportRenovator

more will be added in time

If you are interested in one of our games and you want to know everything about them first hand, join our community Discord today and don’t miss a thing! 

Remember, Discord is always the first place we share news, updates, and possible ideas that might be implemented in the game! If you want to be part of our community and help us make better games, feel free to join us anytime and share your ideas!
We are always open to your feedback!
